messages:
zoe: hey all, day 1 here. trying to run an APAC inference smoke test that needs access to an AWS ECR repo in ap-northeast-1 and a GCP KMS key in asia-northeast1. getting 403 on ECR pull and PERMISSION_DENIED on KMS decrypt. who owns region enablement and billing links for APAC sandboxes?

infra-bot: welcome @zoe! For APAC access tag @arman (infra) or @jules (platform). onboarding checklist: https://redwood.internal/docs/onboarding/apac-access

arman: hi @zoe. can you paste the exact ECR error and the gcloud kms error? also run `aws sts get-caller-identity` and `gcloud auth list` if possible.

zoe: ECR error: "access denied for repository redwood-inference-ecr" when running `docker pull 111111111111.dkr.ecr.ap-northeast-1.amazonaws.com/test-image:latest`. AWS CLI `ecr get-authorization-token` returns AccessDenied. GCP KMS error when decrypting secret: `PERMISSION_DENIED: Permission iam.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt denied on resource`

jules: sounds like two permission grants needed. For ECR you need an IAM policy allowing `ecr:GetAuthorizationToken` and repo pull on that account or a cross-account role. For GCP KMS you need `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` on the key. Are the APAC projects linked to our billing account? sometimes billing not linked for new APAC sandboxes.

zoe: i used the quickstart project id `redwood-infra-apac-sbx`. Billing page shows "No billing account linked" and quotas show 0 GPUs for asia-northeast1.

billing: @zoe we manage billing links for APAC and need a signed cost-owner approval. Please open FIN-5012 with project id and justification. Note: for APAC we also require a regional compliance checklist (data residency) before linking for customer-facing work.

arman: infra note: our org policy currently blocks creation of resources in some APAC locations by default. We enable per-project on request due to capacity/market controls. I'll check project-level IAM and org-policy. If billing isn't linked we won't be able to allocate quotas or enable the region.

zoe: ran `aws sts get-caller-identity`: `{ "UserId": "AIDZOE...", "Account": "666666666666", "Arn": "arn:aws:iam::666666666666:user/zoe" }`

jules: thanks. short-term options: (A) run the test in us-east1 or ap-south1 where your role is allowed, (B) open INFRA-5013 for infra to grant a temporary cross-account role for ECR pull and GCP temporary decrypt access, or (C) finance links billing and infra enables the APAC region (longer). Which do you prefer?

zoe: need APAC real latency numbers, so prefer temporary grants if possible. i'll open the ticket and include exact commands.

infra-bot: please open INFRA-5013 with caller id, target ECR account id, GCP project id, key name, duration requested (recommend 24h) and manager approval. Tag @arman @jules @billing.

zoe: created INFRA-5013 and attached errors and caller id. requested 24h access for both ECR pull and KMS decrypt.

security: acknowledged INFRA-5013. For APAC access we'll require MFA and audit logs for any cross-account pulls. Also verify the image is from a sandbox repo, not prod. We'll likely approve a scoped role for 24h with logging enabled.

billing: received FIN-5012 linked from INFRA-5013. We'll start the billing link checks. If the project needs sustained APAC quota we will need cost estimation and compliance sign-off.

arman: i'll triage INFRA-5013 now. If org-policy allows, i'll add a trust for `arn:aws:iam::666666666666:user/zoe` to assume a minimal ECR-read role on the ECR account and grant a key-level crypto decrypter on the GCP key for 24h. Will post confirmation here when done.

zoe: thanks team. if you can DM the temporary creds that works. otherwise i'll wait for the role to be added and try again. appreciate the help! :pray:
